About Montra

Personal, professional and attentive.

At Montra, personal attention comes first. Ratree tailors every treatment to your wishes and to what feels right for your body.

You can choose from several Thai massage techniques: from calm and relaxing to firmer and more focused on specific muscle tension. Treatments take place in a quiet, respectful setting.

Not sure which massage suits you? Use the massage finder beforehand, or decide together with Ratree when you get in touch.

01Authentic techniquesTraditional Thai techniques are the foundation, with attention to your personal preferences.
02A calm settingA professional treatment in a quiet space, with respect for your boundaries and comfort.
03From relaxing to firmFrom Thai Oil and Traditional Thai to Deep Tissue, sports massage and targeted treatments.
